# Pricing Strategy Coach

Turn "what should we charge?" into a value-based model customers accept and you can defend — following
the source discipline in [`AGENTS.md`](../../../AGENTS.md). Pairs with [`competitive-analysis-coach`](../competitive-analysis-coach/SKILL.md) and [`business-case-writer`](../business-case-writer/SKILL.md).

## When to use

- The learner must set or revise price and packaging for a product or feature.
- Choosing a pricing model and testing willingness-to-pay before committing.

## Procedure

1. **Anchor on value, not cost:** what the buyer gains, their alternatives, and willingness-to-pay —
   cost-plus sets a floor, not the price.
2. **Pick a value metric:** the unit you charge for (seats, usage, outcomes) — it should scale with
   the value the customer receives, or growth and fairness break.
3. **Choose a model:** subscription, usage-based, per-seat, tiered, or freemium — name the trade-off
   (predictable revenue vs. usage alignment vs. adoption).
4. **Package into good-better-best tiers:** differentiate by value metric and features so each
   segment self-selects; avoid a maze of add-ons.
5. **Apply psychology honestly:** anchoring, a decoy tier, charm pricing, annual discounts — nudges,
   never dark patterns that erode trust.
6. **Test with real data:** interviews, a Van Westendorp price-sensitivity survey, or a live A/B
   test (hand off to [`ab-test-designer`](../ab-test-designer/SKILL.md)) — never guess willingness-to-pay.

## Output shape

```
Product & customer value: … | alternatives: …
Value metric: <unit> — scales with value because …
Model: <subscription | usage | tiered | freemium> — trade-off: …
Tiers: Good <price/metric> | Better … | Best …
Psychology: anchor … | decoy … | charm …
Test plan: <interviews / Van Westendorp / A-B> — real inputs needed
```

## Tips

- Price the value, not the cost — cost-plus leaves money and signal on the table.
- The value metric is the strategy; if it does not scale with value, tiers cannot fix it.
- Willingness-to-pay comes from customers, not a spreadsheet — measure it.
- End with the **Learning Footer** (`AGENTS.md`).
